text:
emma (product): quick thread 1 - we have three parallel asks from sales/legal: BYOK rotation semantics during legal-hold exports, SLA for evidence bundle delivery, and how to surface key metadata in exports. want a short spec to hand to eng + security.
rick (eng): agree. propose: add `kms_key_id`, `kms_key_version`, `export_signature` to export manifest. rotation policy: if key rotated, exported bundles reference the key version used to encrypt at time of export. We MUST preserve old key metadata for at least 3 years for enterprise contracts.
lina (security): +1 on manifest fields. also require signed manifest with HSM-backed signing key (or customer-provided signing for BYOK). acceptance test: verify signature chain + that manifest includes checksum for each shard. export must be reproducible: given export bundle and manifest, verifier can recompute checksums and verify signatures.
jess (legal): legal timeline: when a cust issues a legal hold, they expect export readiness within 48 hours for targeted timeframe and full archive export within 10 days for narrow scope. need an API audit trail: who requested, requester_email, legal_hold_id, custody_ticket. also need retention tagging that prevents scheduled deletion even if tenant TTL expires.
peter (ops): ops concerns: large exports spike egress and CPU. plan: rate-limited export workers, tenant-level quota and backoff. add dashboard card for "pending exports" and FF `exports.job-priority` per-tenant. storage delta: estimates +12% for keeping key-version history.
emma (product): decision items by Thurs EOD: (A) manifest schema + fields, (B) export SLA targets (48h/10d), (C) key retention window, (D) canary rollout cadence.
rick (eng): manifest proto sketch:
```
manifest_v1 = {
  "legal_hold_id": "lh_...",
  "tenant_id": "t_...",
  "requested_by": "user@org.com",
  "time_range": {"from":"2024-10-01","to":"2024-10-10"},
  "objects": [{"path":"s3://.../part-0001.gz","checksum":"sha256:...","size":123456}],
  "kms_key_id": "proj/tenant/key123",
  "kms_key_version": "v3",
  "signatures": [{"algo":"rsa-sha256","sig":"base64...","signer":"redwood-hsm-v1"}]
}
```
we'll produce a small compatibility shim for older consumers.
lina (security): for BYOK customers we must record `customer_keystore_id` and whether key escrow is enabled. if customer refuses escrow, require them to supply verification key for signatures or we fallback to Redwood-signed manifests with documented implications.
jess (legal): add `legal_hold.reason` free-text and `legal_hold.issued_at` iso-ts. also require an audit-report endpoint that can return evidence bundle metadata without downloading full export (for quick legal triage).
peter (ops): canary: 3 tenants for 72h -> 15% for 5 days -> full. ops will provision an export-queue metric and throttling knobs. will simulate a heavy export in staging with 2x normal dataset.
emma (product): acceptance criteria for launch: 1) manifest schema stable and doc'd, 2) 3 successful signed exports (one BYOK with customer-provided verification key, one BYOK no-escrow, one standard) validated by security within 24h, 3) ops runbook for throttling and retry, 4) legal confirms evidence metadata meets minimal discovery needs.
rick (eng): migration notes: add fields on new exports only. backfill not necessary for prior blobs; but we will surface legacy exports with a generated manifest on-demand (best-effort). implement feature flag `exports.legal-hold-v1` to roll out.
lina (security): checklist: ensure HSM signing keys are rotated monthly, store signing key fingerprints in the manifest, record signing_audit_id in export metadata. also include tamper-evidence by bundling signed manifest inside the archive.
jess (legal): confirm: legal team will run a review on sample bundle within 48h of canary completion.
emma (product): I'll draft RFC and update product backlog INF-3091. pinging @infra-bot for ticket creation. :memo:
infra-bot: ticket INF-3091 created, milestone set to next sprint. automation note: add integration test to run nightly export smoke.
emma (product): thanks all 1 - will share RFC link when ready.
